annotations.text: The whole game as a Telegram conversation. DM or group, same commands: /start, king, shill <mint> <pitch>, paid <id>, hall, fee. Buttons under messages are Telegram inline keyboards (they send the command for you).
One-time deposit address per attempt. Amount = the stake (grows 1% per takeover) + inference estimate, +5%, in the player's own coin. Address is copyable; the key is deleted after the sweep.
Settlement steps arrive as one message that edits itself as each step lands. The verdict shows both sides' scores from the arbiter; the card image is only sent for the king (screens 2 and 5).
The card is the photo attached to 'king' and takeover posts. Element and rarity are tweaks up top; the art is the leCore-rendered creature grown from the coin's numbers. Sample values throughout.
Alternate direction, low-fi: an arcade sticker. Loud in a feed, prints well, but reads less like a trading card and loses the on-chain seriousness of the dark card.
